title: Characterizing Large Language Model Geometry Helps Solve Toxicity Detection and Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Manipulating the intrinsic dimension of prompts containing anti-Asian statements to test if the LLM's RLHF protections can be bypassed to force the generation of racist text.
Prepending related or unrelated contextual sentences to anti-Muslim statements to increase the prompt's intrinsic dimension, evaluating the model's susceptibility to generating Islamophobic text.

Extracting unsupervised geometric spline features from LLM layers and training classifiers (e.g., Random Forest, Logistic Regression) to detect identity hate, insults, and toxicity using the Jigsaw and ToxiGen datasets.
